canonical_question: What should I understand about nondestructive versus destructive edits, and when does it matter?
clarification_questions: What exact source, performance, layer, or edit boundary is involved, and what musical role should survive?
Is the problem audible in the full mix, only in solo, or only on one playback system or section?
What changed immediately before the problem appeared, and can you return to the previous state?

competing_hypotheses.description: Nondestructive versus destructive edits is the main cause of the reported result.
competing_hypotheses.label: Hypothesis 1

competing_hypotheses.description: The problem is primarily performance, source, arrangement, level, monitoring, or room context rather than the named edit/layer technique.
competing_hypotheses.label: Hypothesis 2

competing_hypotheses.description: The technique is appropriate, but its amount, boundary, timing, routing, source hierarchy, or Logic mode is wrong.
competing_hypotheses.label: Hypothesis 3

direct_answer: Region edits, fades, Flex operations, and alternatives preserve recovery; Audio File Editor processes can alter the source file. Choose the least destructive tool that still solves the problem. The goal is not a universal cleanup or stacking rule; define the musical role, preserve recovery, and verify one change in context.
evidence_needed: The exact before state, affected passage, source/layer scope, and current Logic version.
A matched before/after comparison using the same musical section.
The user’s report of what became cleaner, tighter, fuller, smaller, noisier, phasey, or less natural.
Original-versus-derived status for any separated, repaired, consolidated, or resampled audio.
key_distinction: Region edits, fades, Flex operations, and alternatives preserve recovery; Audio File Editor processes can alter the source file. Choose the least destructive tool that still solves the problem.
limitations: Starting values and edit amounts are orientations, not universal presets.
Visual waveforms, grids, meters, and analyzers are diagnostic aids, not proof of musical improvement.
Professional and community sources are context-bound and may disagree.
Exact Logic procedures remain unverified on the owner’s installed build.

logic_guidance.listen_for: whether the edit solves the problem while the untouched source remains immediately recoverable
logic_guidance.location: Logic Tracks area > audio region > Region inspector / Fade tool / Track Alternatives
logic_guidance.risk: A destructive repair can make later comp, timing, or restoration decisions impossible.
logic_guidance.show_me_query: Logic Tracks area > audio region > Region inspector / Fade tool / Track Alternatives
logic_guidance.starting_point: Save an alternative before editing and make one reversible change.
steps: Save a Project Alternative, Track Alternative, or duplicate source before making a consequential edit or layer change.
Duplicate the region or create a Track/Project Alternative, then perform the same small edit non-destructively and compare recovery options.
Compare the same passage at matched perceived loudness in the full arrangement; use solo only to inspect a specific artifact.
Listen for: whether the edit solves the problem while the untouched source remains immediately recoverable.
Stop or back off if: A destructive repair can make later comp, timing, or restoration decisions impossible.
Disable or remove the region edit and return to the saved alternative or untouched source.
logic_guidance.stop_condition: Stop once you can repeatably determine whether the edit solves the problem while the untouched source remains immediately recoverable in the full context. Back off or undo if a destructive repair can make later comp, timing, or restoration decisions impossible.
logic_guidance.undo: Disable or remove the region edit and return to the saved alternative or untouched source.
logic_guidance.version_scope: Logic Pro 12.3 target; verify exact menu labels, Flex modes, stack behavior, fade controls, parameter ranges, and current behavior against the installed version.
logic_guidance.visual_target_query: Logic Tracks area > audio region > Region inspector / Fade tool / Track Alternatives

non_processing_possibilities: Re-record if the source is still available and the defect is severe.
